diagnosis: The compiler errors come from applying the unprimed theorem’s self-test proof to the separate primed theorem, where `hf` is only `Continuous f`. For the designated unprimed theorem, `hf : IsTestFunction f`, so taking `g := f` is valid; the integral of the nonnegative continuous function `x ↦ ⟪f x, f x⟫_ℝ` vanishes, forcing it—and hence `f`—to vanish everywhere.
proof_body:
by
  have hf' := hg f hf
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg] at hf'
  · rw [Continuous.ae_eq_iff_eq] at hf'
    · funext x
      have hf'' := congrFun hf' x
      simpa using hf''
    · have hf : Continuous f := hf.smooth.continuous
      fun_prop
    · fun_prop
  · intro x
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply]
    apply real_inner_self_nonneg'
  · apply IsTestFunction.integrable
    exact IsTestFunction.inner hf hf
